discovery.summary: Generate a single free-form illustration PNG from a prompt via Gemini (clean borderless image, no card/poster chrome). Optional reference images ground the result. Use when you need one realistic or diagrammatic picture of a thing — e.g. an illustration to embed inside other content.

hints.when: first-time use or unsure how to invoke the tool
need the input JSON shape or output path rules

tools.name: mofa_image
tools.spawn_only_message: SUCCESS: Image generation is now running in background. The illustration will be automatically delivered when ready. No further action needed for this request.
tools.description: Generate a single free-form illustration as a PNG image via Gemini. Use for one realistic/diagrammatic picture of a subject (not greeting cards or multi-section posters — use mofa_cards / mofa_infographic for those). The 'out' path MUST be relative. Runs in background — do NOT wait for it.

prompt.description: Description of the illustration to generate

out.description: Output PNG path, RELATIVE to the workspace (e.g. mofa-image-20260618/illustration.png). Never absolute, never prefixed with skill-output/.

ref_images.description: Optional reference image paths to ground the illustration (e.g. a photo of the real subject)
